<p><strong>1. EBITDA Multiple (earnings-:
1. I-EBITDA Multiple (isekelwe emalini): Okuvame kakhulu kumabhizinisi asebenzayo. Inani = EBITDA × imboni eminingi. Iziphindaphinda ze-SA SME zisukela ku-2-5× EBITDA (vs 8-15× ezinkampanini ezisohlwini). Inkampani yobunjiniyela enenzuzo ene-R2m EBITDA ingase idayiswe ngama-R6-8m (3-4× EBITDA). Izinto ezikhulisa ukuphindaphindeka: imali engenayo ephindelelayo, isisekelo samakhasimende ahlukahlukene, ithimba labaphathi elingancikile kumnikazi, umgudu wokukhula oqinile.

2. Ukugeleza Kwemali Enesaphulelo (i-DCF): Iphrojekthi yokugeleza kwemali yamahhala yesikhathi esizayo, isaphulelo sibuye ngenani elilungiswe ubungozi (WACC). Ilungile ngokwetiyori kodwa izwela kakhulu ekuqagelweni. Isetshenziselwa kakhulu amabhizinisi amakhulu noma abeluleki bezezimali ngesikhathi sokukhuthala okufanele.

3. Inani Lempahla Yesamba (NAV): Izimpahla zisusa izikweletu ngevelu yemakethe. Isetshenziselwa amabhizinisi anempahla esindayo (izinkampani zezakhiwo, izimayini, ezokukhiqiza). Ngokuvamile inani lephansi, ukukhathazeka okuqhubekayo kufanele kube nenani elikhulu kunezingxenye zalo.
<p><strong>1. Harvesting losses:</strong:
1. Ukulahleka kokuvuna:Uma unokulahlekelwa okungafezeki kuphothifoliyo yakho, kubone ngonyaka ofanayo wentela njengenzuzo enkulu. Ukulahlekelwa kwe-offset kuzuza irandi ngerandi ngaphambi kokuthi kusebenze izinga lokufakwa.

2. Ukusabalalisa ukukhishwa kuyo yonke iminyaka yentela:Ukukhishwa kwaminyaka yonke kungukusebenzisa-noma-kulahlekelwe-yikho. Uma uhlela ukuthengisa indawo enkulu, ukuthengisa okumangalisayo eminyakeni eminingi kusebenzisa okungafakwanga okuningi kuka-R40 000.

3. Ukugoqa kwe-TFSA: Izimpahla ezingaphakathi kwe-Akhawunti Yokulondoloza Imali Engakhokhi Intela azinayo i-CGT, naphakade. Ukubamba ama-asethi okukhula (equity ETFs) ku-TFSA yakho kuqeda unomphela i-CGT kulawo mafa.

4. Umnikelo oya ku-PBO: Ukunikela ngempahla ehlonishwayo ngokuqondile enhlanganweni ezuzisa umphakathi yeSigaba 18A akukho ngaphansi kwe-CGT futhi kukhiqiza ukudonswa kwentela kufika ku-10% wemali engenayo ekhokhiswa intela.
<p><strong>1. Inter vivos trust:</strong:
1. I-Inter vivos trust: Dlulisela amafa abongayo ku-trust manje. Ukukhula okuzayo kuwela ngaphandle kwefa lakho. Ukudlulisela kuqala i-CGT manje (izindleko zesikhathi esisodwa) kodwa kususa ukukhula okuqhubekayo ekubalweni komsebenzi wezindlu.

2. Isiqiniseko sempilo (Isigaba 3(3)(a)):Inqubomgomo yempilo lapho ifa lingumhlomuli ifakwa endaweni okufanele ikhokhelwe kodwa umshwalense uyayikhokha intela. Lezi zinqubomgomo zakhelwe ukuxhasa intela yezindlu, amaphrimiyamu awukhokha kusengaphambili kahle umsebenzi wakho wefa ngezitolimende.

3. Amafa omshado ukuze kukhuliswe ukuphatheka kahle: Ukwakha incwadi yakho yefa ukuze ifa lakho eliphelele liye koshade naye lihlehlisa wonke umsebenzi ekufeni kwesibili, ngaleso sikhathi ukuncishiswa kungase kushintshile, noma ifa loshade naye osaphila lakhiwe ngendlela ehlukile.

4. Iminikelo phakathi nesikhathi sokuphila kwakho konke:Izipho ezifika ku-R100 000/ngonyaka azikhokhelwa Intela Yeminikelo. Eminyakeni engu-20, u-R2 million ungadluliselwa ngaphandle kwefa lakho, konge u-R400 000 wentela yefa.
<p><strong>1. Sole Proprietor:</strong>:

2. Inkampani Ezimele (Pty Ltd): Inhlangano esemthethweni ehlukene. 27% izinga lentela yebhizinisi. Ukuvikelwa kwesibopho somuntu siqu (kunomkhawulo). Idinga ukubhaliswa kwe-CIPC. Ilungele amabhizinisi angaphezu kuka-R500k inzuzo.

3. Umhlinzeki Wesevisi Yomuntu Siqu (PSP):I-Pty Ltd lapho u-80%+ wemali engenayo ivela ezinsizeni eziya kuklayenti elilodwa noma amabili. U-SARS ukhokha intela yama-PSP ngama-28-45% (hhayi u-27% wezinga lebhizinisi), lolu wugibe osonkontileka abaningi abawela kulo.

<p>Capital Gains Tax applies when you se:
I-Capital Gains Tax isebenza uma uthengisa impahla ngemali engaphezu kwaleyo oyikhokhile. I-CGT AYIYONA intela ehlukile - isebenza ngokufaka ingxenye yenzuzo emalini yakho engenayo.

Kubantu ngabanye: u-40% wenzuzo ufakiwe emalini engenayo ekhokhiswa intela (ebizwa ngokuthi 'isilinganiso sokufakwa'). Uma uzuza u-R100 000, u-R40 000 wengezwa emalini yakho engenayo futhi ukhokhiswa intela ngenani lakho elincane. Ku-36%: i-CGT esebenzayo = R14 400.
<p>Capital Gains Tax is not a separate t:
Intela Yenzuzo Yenhloko-mali (CGT) akuyona intela ehlukile eNingizimu Afrika. Kuyisengezo sentela yemali engenayo. Uma ulahla impahla (uyayithengisa, uyayiphoqa, uyafa, noma uyahlala kwamanye amazwe), i-SARS ifaka ingxenye yenzuzo emalini yakho engenayo entela yalowo nyaka.

Amanani okufaka ka-2024/25:

  • Abantu abazimele: U-40% wenzuzo ufakwe emalini engenayo entela
  • Izinkampani: U-80% ufakekile
  • Amatheste: U-80% ufakekile (u-45% wezinga eliphansi × 80% = okusebenzayo 36%)

Umuntu osezingeni lama-45% ukhokha ngokusebenzayo u-18% we-CGT (45% × 40%). Hhayi u-45%. Lo mehluko ubalulekile.
<p>Capital Gains Tax isn't a separate ta:
I-Capital Gains Tax ayiyona intela ehlukile eNingizimu Afrika. Ukwengeza intela yeholo. Uma ulahla impahla (ukuthengisa, isipho, ukuthuthela kwelinye izwe, noma ukufa), ingxenye yenzuzo yengezwa emalini yakho engenayo ekhokhiswa intela.

Abantu ngabanye bahlanganisa u-40% wenzuzo; phezulu 45% kubakaki lokho 18% ukusebenza izinga (45% × 40%), hhayi 45%. Izihlangu ezimbili ziyasiza: ukukhishwa ngonyaka ka-R50 000 kanye nokungafakwa kwendawo yokuhlala eyisisekelo engu-R3 000 000 (zombili ezikhishwe kuSabelomali sika-2026).

<p>Losing your job with no other income:

Izibonelo: uthisha ofundisa u-R4 000/ngenyanga, i-accountant eyenza ama-freelance tax returns ngo-R6 000/ngenyanga, umklami othatha izinkontileka zangempelasonto.
<p>Loss aversion is the psychological ph: Ukuzonda ukulahlekelwa yinto engokwengqondo lapho ukulahlekelwa kuzwa khona ubuhlungu obuphindwe kabili njengoba izinzuzo ezifanayo zijabulisa. Ukulahlekelwa u-R1 000 kuzwakala kubi kakhulu kunokuzuza u-R1 000 kuzwakala kumnandi. Le-asymmetry idonsa izinqumo zezezimali ezingenangqondo: ukubamba ukulahlekelwa ukutshalwa kwezimali isikhathi eside, ukuthengisa utshalomali oluwinile kusenesikhathi, nokukhokha umshwalense oweqile ngemicimbi engenzeki.
<p>Losses feel roughly twice as intense: Ukulahlekelwa kuzwakala kunamandla ngokuphindwe kabili kunezinzuzo ezifanayo. <p>SA has tax treaties with 80+ countrie:
SA has tax treaties with 80+ countries to prevent the same income being taxed twice. The relief works in two ways:

Exemption method: One country gives up its right to tax. Example: SA-UK treaty, SA residents earning UK rental income may pay UK tax and receive a SA exemption (less common).

Credit method (more common): SA taxes the income but credits foreign tax paid. If the UK deducts 20% tax on R200 000 rental (R40 000), and your SA liability on that income is R90 000, you pay only R50 000 more to SARS.

Dividend withholding tax: When your US ETF pays dividends, the US withholds 30% (15% under treaty if you file W-8BEN). This foreign withholding tax is credited against your SA income tax on those dividends. Your SA broker (EasyEquities, Ninety One) handles the W-8BEN form.

<p>Sell an asset (shares, property, unit:
Sell an asset (shares, property, unit trusts, crypto) for more than you paid and the profit is a capital gain, taxed via CGT. For individuals: a R50 000 annual exclusion (you only count gains above it), then a 40% inclusion rate (40% of the net gain is added to your taxable income). At the top 45% marginal rate that's an 18% effective maximum.

Your primary residence gets a R3 000 000 exclusion (2026/27), which is why most people pay no CGT selling their home. Example: buy shares for R50 000, sell for R120 000 → R70 000 gain, less R50 000 exclusion = R20 000, of which 40% (R8 000) is added to income. And inside a TFSA, capital gains are tax-free entirely.

<p>South Africa taxes residents on their:
South Africa taxes residents on their worldwide income, not just income earned in SA. If you live in SA, your dividends from a US ETF, your rental income from a UK flat, and your freelance income from a Swiss client are all taxable by SARS.

You are a SA tax resident if:

  • You are ordinarily resident in SA (your real home is here), OR
  • You were physically in SA for 91 days in the current year and 549 days in the past 5 years

Many South Africans working abroad incorrectly believe they have stopped being tax residents simply by leaving. Formal tax emigration (changing your tax status to non-resident) is a separate legal process with significant implications.

<p>The <strong>FAIS Ombud</strong> (the:
I-FAIS Ombud (i-Ombud Yabahlinzeki Sezinsizakalo Zezezimali) ixazulula izikhalazo zamakhasimende kuma-FSP/abamele ngendlela efanele, enomnotho nangokushesha. I-Ombud ingaphenyisisa, imake futhi yenze isinqumo esinomthelela womyalelo wenkantolo.

Qaphela: Imithetho Yomkhandlu We-Ombud eqale ukusebenza ngo-1 Julayi 2024 ikhuphule lo mkhawulo usuka kuma-R800 000 waba ngama-R3 500 000. Izinto zakudala zokufunda zisekhipha ama-R800 000 - inani lamanje liyi-R3.5 million.
<p>The <strong>FAIS Ombud</strong> resol: Umxazululi weFAIS Ombud uxazulula izikhalazo zamakhasimende futhi enze izinqumo ngomphumela womyalelo wenkantolo, kuze kufike ku-R3.5 wezigidi (inyuswe isuka ku-R800 000 ngomhlaka-1 Julayi 2024). <p>The <strong>Financial Advisory and In:

<p>The <strong>real interest rate</stron:
I-izinga lenzalo yangempela = izinga lentengo - izinga lokwehla kwamandla emali. Yilokhu okutholwa yimali yakho ngemuva kokuthi ukwehla kwamandla emali kucekele phansi amandla okuthenga.

Isibonelo: I-akhawunti yakho yokulondoloza ikhokha u-9%. Ukwehla kwamandla emali kungu-5.5%. Imbuyiselo yakho yangempela ingu-3.5%, leyo yindlela ingcebo yakho ekhula ngayo ngokwemibandela yamandla okuthenga.

Izilinganiso zangempela ezingezinhle: Uma ukwehla kwamandla emali kweqa izinga lakho lokonga, amandla akho okuthenga ayancipha ngisho noma ibhalansi yakho yerandi ikhula. Ngo-2020-2021, izilinganiso zangempela ze-SA zazicishe zibe ku-zero noma zibe negethivu, imali yayilahlekelwa inani buthule.

Ekwakheni ingcebo yesikhathi eside, udinga izimpahla ezihlala zidlula ukwehla kwamandla emali ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Leyo yimpikiswano eyinhloko yokutshala izimali kumasheya kunokugcina konke ukonga kuyimali.
<p>The <strong>repo rate</strong> (repur:
Izinga lengozi/isilinganiso se-repo (izinga lokuthenga kabusha) yizinga lenzalo lapho i-South African Reserve Bank (SARB) iboleka khona imali ngobusuku obubodwa kumabhange ezohwebo. Yileso esinamandla amakhulu esetshenziswa yi-SARB ukuphatha ukunyuka kwamanani e-SA.

Izinga le-repo libeka phansi wonke amanzinga lenzalo emnothweni. Yonke imali yokubolekwa kwezindlu, imali yokubolekwa kwezimoto, ikhadi lesikweletu, nesikhwama sokulondoloza eNingizimu Afrika ekugcineni kubiza ngokuqhathaniswa nalokho.

Umongo ka-2024: Izinga le-repo laliyi-8.25% iningi lika-2024. I-SARB ilinciphise laba u-8.0% ngoSeptemba 2024 futhi labuye laba u-7.75% ngoNovemba 2024, ukunciphisa kokuqala kusukela ngo-2020, ngenkathi i-COVID ihambisa amanani ezansi kakhulu ku-3.5%.
<p>The <strong>repo rate</strong> is wha: Izinga le-repo yilokho i-SARB ekukhokhisa amabhange. Zonke izinqumo zihambisa imali phakathi kwababoleki nabalondolozi: ukunyuka kwamanani kulimaza noma ubani ongebhondi futhi kusiza noma ubani onediphozithi. Amanani athinta ukunyuka kwamanani ngokucisha isidingo, futhi umthelela ufika sekudlule izinyanga eziningi.
<p>The <strong>SARB repo rate</strong> d: I-SARB repo rate ishayela izindleko zakho zokuboleka. I-Prime = repo + 3.5%, futhi iningi lemali mboleko yezindlu inenani eliphansi kakhulu. Njalo umnyakazo ongu-1% kwibhondi ka-R1m cishe u-R500/ngenyanga (≈R6 000/ngonyaka). Amazinga amisiwe athenga isiqiniseko ngeprimiyamu; okuguquguqukayo kuyawina lapho amanani ehla. <p>The idea that renting is 'throwing mo:

<p>The idea that renting is \"throwing m:
Umqondo wokuthi ukuqasha kuwukuchitha imali kuwelinye lamanga olimaza kakhulu kwezezimali zomuntu siqu. Ukuqasha kuvame ukuba yisinqumo esihlakaniphile sezezimali kuye ngezimo zakho.

Ukuqasha kunengqondo uma:

Izindleko zethuba lediphozithi yakho: R200 000 ediphozithini inciphisa imali mboleko yakho kanye nenzalo. Kodwa R200 000 etshalwe esikhwameni sezibambiso esihlukahlukene ngo-12% ngonyaka ikhula ifinyelele ku-R620 000 eminyakeni eyi-10.
